ST-Standard ICE-04 Plus High-Performance Gaming Laptop Cooling Pad (4-Fan Thermal System / Digital LCD Screen / 7-Position Adjustable Height / Blue LED Lighting / Dual USB Ports / 1-Year Local Warranty)

Prevent thermal throttling and preserve your mobile system efficiency with the ST-Standard ICE-04 Plus High-Performance Gaming Laptop Cooling Pad, available at Turbo Computer Egypt with a full 1-Year official local agent warranty layout. Specifically engineered with a durable iron mesh top surface and a rugged plastic chassis structure, this cooling pad supports laptops up to 15.6 Inch display dimensions smoothly. Powered by an advanced quad-fan array incorporating two 125mm high-volume main fans paired with two 70mm targeted high-speed auxiliary fans, it drives rapid heat dissipation directly across critical hardware hot-spots. The pad features 7 customizable ergonomic elevation levels to optimize typing comfort while eliminating neck strain during marathon sessions. Equipped with a clear digital LCD control panel to monitor fan speeds alongside dual USB pass-through ports and built-in anti-slip pads, this low-noise thermal solution guarantees optimal platform performance.
